name: Race Dash
author: Sedz
description: A steering wheel LCD laid out like a real F1 dash: last lap, RPM, live delta, speed, lap, SOC with a 20-segment bar, tyre temperatures and wear, gear, position, fuel, gaps, fuel mix, ERS mode and brake bias, with pop-ups for setting changes, safety cars and red flags. Reads the game's own UDP telemetry packets in the game (passed through unchanged, no sockets opened).

options.label: Delta against
options.description: What the live delta compares your lap with: the previous lap or your best lap of the session.

options.label: Flag screen
options.description: Flags (red flag, safety car, VSC, yellow, blue) fill the whole dash: briefly when they come out (4 s, then a blinking strip along the top edge), or for as long as they are out.

options.label: Page button (UDP Action)
options.description: Bind a button (wheel, controller or keyboard) to this "UDP Action" in the game's Controls menu: it switches the dash between the race and car pages. 0 turns it off. Needs the game's UDP telemetry on.

options.label: Tyres cold below (°C)
options.description: Tyre temperatures below this show blue.

options.label: Tyres hot above (°C)
options.description: Tyre temperatures above this show red; between the two limits they show green.

options.label: Tyre wear amber from (%)
options.description: Tyre wear from this shows amber.

options.label: Tyre wear red from (%)
options.description: Tyre wear from this shows red.

options.label: Debug log
options.description: Write the dash's lap timing and values to swofty/loader.log every 10 seconds.
